articles.title: 500x Faster: NASA's New AI Chip Could Give Spacecraft a Mind of Their Own
articles.summary: Spacecraft today rely on sluggish, radiation-proof computers from the 90s. NASA's new chip is 500 times more powerful, survived brutal testing at JPL, and could let deep-space probes make real-time decisions using AI. It's a game-changer for Mars missions.

articles.title: Schrödinger's Clock: Scientists May Soon Watch Time Flow at Two Speeds at Once
articles.summary: A new study in Physical Review Letters proposes using ultracold ion clocks to observe time in a quantum superposition — ticking faster and slower simultaneously. It's the twin paradox meets Schrödinger's cat, and the tech is finally ready.

articles.title: SpaceX's Starship V3 Set for Critical Test Flight After 7-Month Hiatus
articles.summary: SpaceX targets May 20 for the first Starship V3 launch — Flight 12 — from Starbase, Texas. The upgraded rocket will deploy dummy Starlink satellites and camera probes before a planned Indian Ocean splashdown. NASA's Artemis 4 lunar landing hinges on its success.
